name: A Date With Whatshisface
source:
"A Date With Whatshisface" is a short horror-themed visual novel where you go on a date with a guy or girl whose name you don't remember. 

[from [url=https://burnberry.itch.io/a-date-with-whatshisface]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《A Date With Whatshisface》是一部以恐怖为主题的短篇视觉小说，你将与一个你不记得名字的男人或女孩约会。

[来自[url=https://burnberry.itch.io/a-date-with-whatshisface]itch.io[/url]]
